newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Jan producer price index up 1.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Jan producer price index up 1.4 pct.

text.p: Colombia's producer price index rose 1.4 percent in January, sharply lower than the 3 percent increase during the same month last year, the central bank said.
It said the increase meant that producer prices had risen 12.7 percent percent over the past 12 months.
This compared to a 17.7 percent rise in the PPI in the 12 months ending January 31, 1996, the bank said.
The National Statistics Department will report on the January consumer price index at 1400 local/1900 GMT Saturday.
